summary: Clone PerformanceMark detail with structured serialization/deserialization before storing it.

semantics.identity: cloned objects are not aliased to source
semantics.ordering: serialization occurs during mark construction before entry is returned

caveats: Reuse the canonical structured-clone runtime when available; do not JSON-stringify detail.

tests.name: detail is cloned
tests.input: const d={x:1}; const m=performance.mark('x',{detail:d}); d.x=2; console.log(m.detail.x);
